item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00925","case1_error":"Adds costs for 14 individual balloons and two packs, counting excess balloons instead of one pack plus four singles.","case2_error":"Subtracts coupon savings from the discounted payment instead of adding them back; also mislabels dollars as cents.","reason":"The first combines overlapping purchase quantities; the second reverses the discount adjustment and mishandles units.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00926","case1_error":"Omits the factor of two in two dozen, treating each set as 12 cups instead of 24.","case2_error":"Omits the factor of two for points per win, counting each win as one point.","reason":"Both omit an explicitly required multiplicative factor when converting counts into totals.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J00927","case1_error":"Counts the two mother lambs again even though they are already included in the original six.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 12 + 6 - 1 + 5 - 2 as 18 instead of 20.","reason":"The first double-counts a subset in its relation; the second numerically evaluates a correct expression incorrectly.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00928","case1_error":"Subtracts only Ryan's quarter and omits Chris's withdrawal.","case2_error":"Counts the three cupcakes given away as Sarah's retained cupcakes instead of using the six remaining.","reason":"The first omits a required withdrawal; the second substitutes the transferred portion for its complement.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00929","case1_error":"Provides an unsupported final total of 22 after correctly writing (56 / 8) + (48 / 6), which yields 15.","case2_error":"Provides an unsupported final total of 30 after correctly writing (32 + 13 + 15) - 20, which yields 40.","reason":"Both give incorrect final numbers after correct formulas without showing a calculation that identifies a more specific arithmetic mistake.","judgment":"same"}]}
